about: PLAN 79.55: the conditions on a state that the bit statement of exposed_by_cases is made under (rule_lemma_bits.py). Each is an ASSUMPTION: at most one fact of the group holds. They are well-formedness conditions of a state, not rules of the description; they are not shown here to hold at every state the game reaches (the fixtures and seeded games print whether any is broken).
